title: Punjab HED Releases 2026 CTI Tentative Merit List
excerpt: The Higher Education Department in Punjab has published the tentative merit list for College Teaching Intern candidates for 2026.
body_html: The Higher Education Department (HED) of Punjab has officially released the tentative merit list for College Teaching Intern (CTI) candidates for the year 2026. Applicants who applied for the internship positions can now check the newly published preliminary list to review their standing.
